raw_text: BREAKING: Myanmar military airstrikes in northern Chin State, very close to Indian border. Explosions reported within 5km of Mizoram's Champhai district. At least two fighter jets involved. Chin resistance forces say a village near Rihkhawdar was targeted. Refugees already moving toward Indian border crossing.
clean_text: Myanmar military airstrikes in northern Chin State within 5km of Mizoram border. Explosions heard in Champhai district. Refugees moving toward Indian border.
